title: Polylogarithmic updates for bounded rank-width

import_provenance.original_statement: Can a graph that always has rank-width at most k be maintained under edge insertions and deletions with an implicit rank-decomposition of width O(k) and f(k)polylog(n) amortized update time? This is an editorial data-structure extension of Fomin and Korhonen’s branch-decomposition refinement framework.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The dynamic follow-up gives subpolynomial, rather than polylogarithmic, update time. The polylogarithmic dynamic tree-width results concern a different graph parameter.
